items.text: Bear rug and regular rug now provide full (100%) comfort within closer ranges and gradual falloff, fixing previous 25% solo comfort values.
Flashlight weapon now toggles on/off with right-click like a torch, with updated animations and server‑side extinguish on sleep/disconnect.
Semi‑automatic pistol receives more damage falloff at range and its high‑quality craft cost increased from 4 to 6.
HAB armour colliders set up correctly on client and server, allowing proper removal and adding a collision mesh for the frame.
Adjusted enemy body spawn chances: increased SMG body spawn chance slightly and decreased Rifle body spawn chance slightly to improve mid‑game balance.
Rabbit assets (animation, model, prefab) added, making rabbits appear in the world.
New UI panels for selling animals and previewing sale rewards introduced, with sale info now displayed in‑game.
Old AI units no longer flee when the player jumps, fixing erratic behavior.
Cargo ship event now preserves crate locations and loot cycles across server restarts, fixing despawn and save‑load issues.
Hackable crates receive visual flag updates and puzzle‑reset alerts are skipped after forced resets, improving event stability.
Session modal overflow fixed: description scroll works and long texts no longer block disconnect button.
Store item overlay page now supports DynamicFullscreenSprite and DynamicGallerySprite fields, with updated inspector and layout handling.
SteamFriendsList.Refresh optimized to eliminate large lag spikes when authorizing many friends to turrets or other objects.

2026-08-25.summary:
### Comfort & Deployables
- Bear rug and regular rug now provide full (100%) comfort within closer ranges and gradual falloff, fixing previous 25% solo comfort values.

### Combat & Gear
- Flashlight weapon now toggles on/off with right-click like a torch, with updated animations and server‑side extinguish on sleep/disconnect.
- Semi‑automatic pistol receives more damage falloff at range and its high‑quality craft cost increased from 4 to 6.
- HAB armour colliders set up correctly on client and server, allowing proper removal and adding a collision mesh for the frame.
- Adjusted enemy body spawn chances: increased SMG body spawn chance slightly and decreased Rifle body spawn chance slightly to improve mid‑game balance.

### Animals & Livestock
- Rabbit assets (animation, model, prefab) added, making rabbits appear in the world.
- New UI panels for selling animals and previewing sale rewards introduced, with sale info now displayed in‑game.

### AI & NPC
- Old AI units no longer flee when the player jumps, fixing erratic behavior.

### Events, Crates & UI
- Cargo ship event now preserves crate locations and loot cycles across server restarts, fixing despawn and save‑load issues.
- Hackable crates receive visual flag updates and puzzle‑reset alerts are skipped after forced resets, improving event stability.
- Session modal overflow fixed: description scroll works and long texts no longer block disconnect button.
- Store item overlay page now supports DynamicFullscreenSprite and DynamicGallerySprite fields, with updated inspector and layout handling.
- SteamFriendsList.Refresh optimized to eliminate large lag spikes when authorizing many friends to turrets or other objects.

items.text: Fixed frog animation glitches, corrected sideways skating and movement speed, and added a new water‑seeking 'interested' state where frogs croak and move toward shallow water.
Added a drinking water need for livestock, allowing them to hydrate from containers or natural water sources.
Enabled Stable B for animal trading, introducing basic NPC conversation and selling mechanics for animals.
Added restoreHierarchy flag to pooled vehicles, fixing UI pooling issues for vehicle objects.
Improved car handling: fixed handbrake logic, prevented duck toggle lock, applied raw tyre force, refined suspension, steering, grip, and added visual rear‑wheel lock during handbrake.
Introduced a configurable setting to adjust the drone detonation distance and updated helicopter passenger seat weapons to apply aim sway scaled by movement speed.

Various UI stability and visual fixes: health bar now shows when hitting monument blockers, store prop drawer fallback image added, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference crash prevented, arrow revamp icons corrected, and homing launcher UI now displays 'Keep on target' with lock‑on timer reduced by 30%.
Hotbar now allows swapping of overstacks via server‑side RPC, repair bench functionality fixed, and random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible outcome.
SAM sites receive new anti‑drone buffs: proximity‑fuse missiles, 2.25× speed lead without aim error, and ability to destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air.

2026-08-24.summary:
### Animals
- Fixed frog animation glitches, corrected sideways skating and movement speed, and added a new water‑seeking 'interested' state where frogs croak and move toward shallow water.
- Added a drinking water need for livestock, allowing them to hydrate from containers or natural water sources.
- Enabled Stable B for animal trading, introducing basic NPC conversation and selling mechanics for animals.

### Vehicles
- Added restoreHierarchy flag to pooled vehicles, fixing UI pooling issues for vehicle objects.
- Improved car handling: fixed handbrake logic, prevented duck toggle lock, applied raw tyre force, refined suspension, steering, grip, and added visual rear‑wheel lock during handbrake.
- Introduced a configurable setting to adjust the drone detonation distance and updated helicopter passenger seat weapons to apply aim sway scaled by movement speed.

### UI & Inventory
- Various UI stability and visual fixes: health bar now shows when hitting monument blockers, store prop drawer fallback image added, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference crash prevented, arrow revamp icons corrected, and homing launcher UI now displays 'Keep on target' with lock‑on timer reduced by 30%.
- Hotbar now allows swapping of overstacks via server‑side RPC, repair bench functionality fixed, and random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible outcome.

### Gameplay & Balance
- SAM sites receive new anti‑drone buffs: proximity‑fuse missiles, 2.25× speed lead without aim error, and ability to destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air.
